requested_outcome: Vacation last-minute deals use today until 14:00 Israel time and tomorrow from 14:00, with automatic refresh and no regression to the four weekend periods.
natural_destination: The vacation last-minute tab and permanent last-minute page.
authorization_boundary: Local source repair and verification are authorized. Publication is not authorized by this correction.

lesson_bundle.reason: The prior implementation encoded the wrong time behavior and needs an exact boundary regression.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The precise pre-cutoff, boundary and post-cutoff states must pass, together with the affected family.

lesson_bundle.reason: The same shared deal clock drives multiple discovery rails and period tabs.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The correction must preserve the four weekend periods and shared refresh behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: The displayed stay date is a time-zone-sensitive public data promise.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Tests must use Asia/Jerusalem and verify exact returned dates rather than labels alone.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The card still requests tomorrow before 14:00.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Make the last-minute period derive from the shared first eligible date.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: At 13:59:59 Israel time the period returns today's date.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The switch happens at 14:01 or remains stale after 14:00.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Move the shared cutoff to exactly 14:00 and bind the request cache identity to the deal clock.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: At 14:00:00 the period returns tomorrow and the client request identity changes.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Fixing last minute moves Thursday or Friday weekend tabs incorrectly.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep weekday period computation separate and run boundary tests for all four tabs.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All four weekend period dates remain correct before and after the cutoff.

affected_family: shared event and spa deal-clock consumers

sources.label: Current user correction
sources.source: Active conversation: show today and switch to tomorrow at 14:00

midpoint_gate.trigger: The date helper and boundary unit tests pass before the component cache behavior is changed.

attack_questions: Can any second at or after 14:00 still return today?
Can a mounted page retain the pre-cutoff API response after the clock changes?
Did the shared cutoff break event, spa or weekend-period date eligibility?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: A rendered local last-minute rail must request the expected date on both sides of the cutoff.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests for shared clock, home-deal dates, client request cache identity and all period tabs must pass.

effectiveness.baseline: Current code always selects tomorrow for period tomorrow and switches the shared clock at 14:01.
effectiveness.target: One causal implementation with exact boundary coverage and no repeated correction for this rule.
